mapper.sql: select id, notify_type, todo_kind, biz_type, biz_id, project_id, project_code, project_name, title, content, receiver_id, receiver_role_id, route_path, route_query, priority, status, due_time, read_time, done_time, ignore_reason, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from proj_notify
mapper.insert: insert into proj_notify ( notify_type, todo_kind, biz_type, biz_id, project_id, project_code, project_name, title, content, receiver_id, receiver_role_id, route_path, route_query, priority, status, due_time, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{notifyType}, #{todoKind}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{projectId}, #{projectCode}, #{projectName}, #{title}, #{content}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverRoleId}, #{routePath}, #{routeQuery}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{dueTime}, #{createBy}, now() ) on conflict (biz_type, biz_id, receiver_id) where del_flag = '0' do nothing
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(case when notify_type = 'todo' and status in ('unread','read') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as "todoCount", coalesce(sum(case when notify_type = 'message' and status = 'unread' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as "messageCount", coalesce(sum(case when notify_type = 'todo' and status in ('unread','read') and priority = 'high' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as "highTodoCount" from proj_notify where del_flag = '0' and receiver_id = #{receiverId}
select coalesce(max(id), 0) from proj_notify where del_flag = '0' and receiver_id = #{receiverId}
mapper.update: update proj_notify set status = 'read', read_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} and status = 'unread' and del_flag = '0'

update proj_notify set status = 'ignored', ignore_reason = #{reason}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} and notify_type = 'todo' and status in ('unread','read') and del_flag = '0'

update proj_notify set priority = 'high', update_time = now() where del_flag = '0' and notify_type = 'todo' and status in ('unread','read') and priority = 'normal' and create_time < now() - (#{dueDays} * interval '1 day')
and receiver_id = #{receiverId}
